text:
kevin_sales: Quick heads-up  Prospect (Velox Capital) is gating the deal on two items: (1) emergency key swap for BYO-KMS must be <= 180s for new encryptions, (2) invoices must show a separate HSM call line per API request (they need it for internal chargebacks). Can we confirm technical limits + propose SOW verbiage?

samira_se: Clarify what they mean by "emergency swap": new writes prevented on old key within 180s, or total propagation/CRL across all nodes in 180s?

kevin_sales: They want new writes to start using the rotated key within 180s. Reads can continue on old keys for 24h. They explicitly said they don't want a soft window—customers operations wants a measurable guarantee.

zhou_eng: Short answer: doable with caveats. Mechanism: rotate in KMS -> push new wrapping key to all HSM proxies -> invalidate key cache + optionally force TLS renegotiation. The difficult part is forcing all long-lived app TLS sessions to rehandshake; we can drop session TTLs or rotate proxies' session certs to force new connections. Expect a transient spike in errors and tail-latency during cache purge. I'll draft numbers for 20/200/1000 rps.

hana_sre: Runbook (high level): 1) create/import key in customer's KMS 2) distribute to HSM proxy fleet 3) trigger cache invalidation RPCs + rotate session certs if requested 4) canary traffic (optional) 5) full cutover 6) monitor error rate & rollback if threshold exceeded. Emergency path: skip canary, force invalidation. Canary window recommendation: 30-60s. Note: forced path likely spikes error rate ~0.5-3% for 30-90s.

marco_security: Security asks: we need customer's KMS attestation + HSM vendor certs. If they want FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or a split-key import ceremony (M-of-N), that adds lead time and a small implementation fee. Also require signed audit logs of rotation events and retention policy. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/byo-kms (internal).

alejandra_billing: Billing: we can expose a SKU BYO_HSM_CALL and surface per-call lines. Engineering must emit metering tags per proxied request. Pricing: we recommend a tiered per-call table rather than a flat fee. What price did they propose?

kevin_sales: They suggested $0.009 per HSM call and asked for a volume discount past 1M calls/mo.

zhou_eng: Cost/latency sanity: $0.009 is plausible at low volumes. For bursts (1k rps) prefer commit/reserved capacity. Latency hit if HSM unwrap per request: add ~100-300ms depending on region and session reuse. With warm caches and connection pooling 95th can be ~120ms.

hana_sre: Networking: strongly prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink over NAT. Firewall: allow outbound 443 to proxy IPs. Provide a template TF snippet below for peering.

hana_sre: ```tf
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "redwood_peer" {
  vpc_id        = var.customer_vpc
  peer_vpc_id   = var.redwood_vpc
  auto_accept   = false
  tags = { Name = "velox-redwood-peer" }
}
```

marco_security: Proposed SOW language (draft): "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests encrypted with newly-rotated keys within one hundred eighty (180) seconds of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may involve forced cache invalidation and TLS session renegotiation which can cause transient elevated error rates; Redwood will provide signed rotation audit artifacts upon request. Exceptions include network partitions, force majeure, and customer-caused misconfiguration."

alejandra_billing: If they demand a firm SLA we should propose a measurable target: e.g., "95% of new write requests in a single customer region will use the new key within 180 seconds of initiation." Legal will want measurement method & carve-outs.

zhou_eng: Action items: I'll post a latency/error impact matrix for forced vs staged rotation at 20/200/1000 rps in ~24h.

hana_sre: I'll prepare network templates and an egress IP list sample.

marco_security: I'll DM Kevin the exact document checklist and whether they require attestation artifacts.

alejandra_billing: I'll draft a tiered pricing table and sample invoice layout (line items: BYO_HSM_CALL, BYO_HSM_COMMIT). Need engineering metering to be enabled.

infra-bot: Note: per-call metering for BYO-KMS enabled behind feature flag. PR #5312 tracks prod rollout.

kevin_sales: Thanks all  I'll schedule a 20m call with Velox for tomorrow after we have the matrix and draft SOW. Please ping if any blockers.
